name: christmas-eve
description: 8-bit Christmas Eve theme: a log hut and a lamp post in falling snow under a full moon, with sleighs on the road and in the sky

onlyForEmail.title: Only for account email
onlyForEmail.description: Turn the theme on by itself only when the signed-in account's email is exactly this one. Leave empty to turn it on everywhere. /christmas-eve still turns it on in any session.
